title: I built this game with Claude
note: Creator reel. All footage is real gameplay recorded from the game's own builds with Godot's movie writer (examples/game_reel/capture_gameplay.gd). The finished reel never names the game's repository, account, branches or internal docs (checked by qa_game_reel.py against the terms in private_terms_file, which is git-ignored so the names never enter this repository).

beats.narration: Making games used to feel impossible without a whole development team.
But I wanted to see what I could build with Claude.

prompt.label: MY FIRST PROMPT · EXCERPT
lines: Players rotate conveyor belt tiles to guide packages from sources to matching destinations.
The game should feel: Immediately understandable · Visually satisfying · Extremely responsive

beats.narration: So I gave it my game idea, and started making it playable.
Characters with personalities. Thirty-six puzzles, five worlds, and hints that teach.
I kept reviewing it, finding problems, and asking Claude to improve things.

split.note: same level · same taps · two real builds

claims.36 puzzles: 36 curated levels in apps/game/data/levels/curated.json at the latest build
claims.5 worlds: Little Workshop, Candy Factory, Parcel Station, Neon Circuit, Space Logistics (scripts/ui/worlds.gd)
claims.characters with personalities: The Crew: Bloop, Zip, Glitch, Mochi, Captain Naps, Dr. Rix (docs character system); reactions recorded in the clips
claims.hints that teach: three-step hints (area, tile, rotation); 'Hint 1 of 3' recorded in fail_fix
claims.built with Claude: every commit after the initial README is co-authored by Claude Code, from the creator's five written briefs
claims.still in development: not published; no device testing; iOS not compiled (known limitations)
